CJV8: I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet forever.
On Guru's feet, I have ever fixed my mind.
J988: By Guru's Grace, my mind and body are immaculate and pure; I meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||
On Guru's favour, my soul and body are rendered pure, and the immaculate Name do I meditate upon.
BFBA: From birth to death, everything is for You.
From birth to death I have decided my entire life for Yours service, O Lord!
9925: You bestow greatness upon those whom You have forgiven.
You givest glory to him, whom You forgivest.
H6LB: O Nanak, meditating forever on the Naam, you shall be blessed in both birth and death. ||8||1||2||
O Nanak! do You ever contemplate over the Lord's Name shall bedeck your birth and death.
4XFL: My God is Immaculate, Inaccessible and Infinite.
My Lord is immaculate, inaccessible and infinite.
DSFP: Without a scale, He weighs the universe.
Without a balance, He weighs the world.
HD6U: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands. Chanting His Glorious Praises, he is absorbed into the Lord of Virtue. ||1||
He, who is resigned to the Guru's will, understands God By uttering His praises, the mortal is observed in the praise worthy Lord.
SPZ6: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord.
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice to those who abide God's Name in their hearts.
2656: Those who are committed to Truth remain awake and aware night and day. They are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||
They who are attached to Truth, remain wakeful, night and day, and obtain honour in the True Court. Pause.
FYNN: He Himself hears, and He Himself sees.
God Himself hears and Himself sees.
G01M: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, become acceptable.
On whom He casts His merciful glance, that person becomes acceptable.
13CW: They are attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches; as Gurmukh, they live the Truth. ||2||
He, whom the Lord Himself touches, gets, attached with Him, and through the Guru, practices truth.
D4EB: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads-whose hand can they take?
Whose support can seek, he, whom the Lord Himself misleads?
WCZ6: That which is pre-ordained, cannot be erased.
What so pre-prescribed, that can not be erased.
5JS4: Those who meet the True Guru are very fortunate and blessed; through perfect karma, He is met. ||3||
Very fortunate are they, whom the True Guru meets. Through the perfect destiny is the True Guru met.
C47R: The young bride is fast asleep in her parents' home, night and day.
In her father's home the bride is ever in sleep.
2T8N: She has forgotten her Husband Lord; because of her faults and demerits, she is abandoned.
Her husband she has forgotten and owing to evil deeds is she forsaken.
7H8L: She wanders around continually, crying out, night and day. Without her Husband Lord, she cannot get any sleep. ||4||
Night and day she ever wanders bewailing. Sans her spouse she gets not sleep.
D00B: In this world of her parents' home, she may come to know the Giver of peace,
One comes to realise her Lord, the giver of peace.
8NMC: if she subdues her ego, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
who in this world, subduing her ego, understand the verity of the Gurbani.
3C58: Her bed is beautiful; she ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord forever. She is adorned with the Decorations of Truth. ||5||
Beautiful is her couch, she ever enjoys her beloved and makes the ornamentation of truthfulness.
